When looking for the best value-for-money without sacrificing quality, here are our top two options:
1. Handcrafted Solid & Geometric Cement Tiles: Made from high-density, durable cement with eco-friendly CO₂-absorbing CaptureCrete® technology, these offer timeless style, incredible strength for heavy-use floors or walls, and a great long-term value.
2. Artisanal Zellige Tiles: Known for their distinct handcrafted texture and subtle gloss variations that catch light beautifully. They add a high-end look to backsplashes and accent walls at an accessible price point, though they are lighter-weight than cement tiles.
